checkpoint_protocol: At session start fetch live default branch and both digests; read PROJECT_STATE.md, WORKPLAN.md, WORK_LOG.md and relevant research/supporting documents.
Identify verified completions, unfinished tasks, blockers, dependencies and the next unblocked action; do not ask the user to repeat recorded history.
After meaningful progress update affected research/supporting documents and WORK_LOG.md; reconcile PROJECT_STATE.md.
Change WORKPLAN.md only when roadmap, priorities, dependencies or workflow genuinely change.
Read back and verify PROJECT_STATE.md, WORKPLAN.md and WORK_LOG.md.
Refresh SESSION_DIGEST.md from verified working documents; refresh SESSION_DIGEST.json last.
Read back both digests and verify agreement with the three working documents.
Record exact next action, relevant paths, blockers/dependencies and constraints.

diagram_policy.format: Genuine visual illustrations; never ASCII art.
diagram_policy.timing: Create or improve only when the underlying argument and evidence are stable; otherwise defer.

claim_discipline: Never claim saved, completed, published, deployed, tested or audited without evidence.
Distinguish drafted, committed, read-back verified, tested and independently reviewed.
